# platform-orchestrator_plugin_installation (Data Source)

Finds the installation of a plugin in the Plugin Manager. A plugin has at most one installation that is not purged. Installing and every other lifecycle step are Plugin Manager operator workflows in `v1alpha`, for example with `octl plugin-manager`. The provider's token needs the platform permission `plugin_manager_read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "platform-orchestrator_plugin_installation" "progressive_rollouts" {
  plugin_id = "dev.stellwerk.progressive-rollouts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin_id` (String) The plugin, for example `dev.stellwerk.progressive-rollouts`.

### Read-Only

- `availability` (String) Derived from the state: `available` while active, `not_enabled` (safety-only) while disabled, `unavailable` while installed, `not_installed` once uninstalled.
- `default_approval_policies` (Map of String) Deployment approval scope to authorization policy of every enablement Core creates on its own in mode `all`.
- `default_timezone` (String) The IANA timezone of every enablement Core creates on its own in mode `all`.
- `installation_id` (String) The Core-assigned UUID of the installation.
- `licence` (Attributes) Only when the served package requires a licence, otherwise null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--licence))
- `organization_mode` (String) `selected` while a platform operator enables each organization, `all` while Core enables every organization, existing and created later, except those whose enablement is disabled. Set the mode with `octl plugin-manager organization-mode`; the provider does not manage it.
- `organizations` (Attributes List) Every organization the installation is enabled for, ordered by organization ID. A `disabled` enablement keeps the plugin safety-only for that organization and, in mode `all`, is the organization's opt-out. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))
- `package_sha256` (String) The digest of the package Core serves.
- `pending_organizations` (List of String) Only in mode `all`: the active organizations without an enablement, which Core could not enable when they were created because the plugin host was off or the installation-wide grant's organization limit was reached. Running `octl plugin-manager organization-mode <installation> all` again enables them. Empty otherwise.
- `state` (String) `installed`, `active`, `disabled` or `uninstalled`.

<a id="nestedatt--licence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `licence`

Read-Only:

- `enabled_organizations` (Number) The enabled enablements of the installation, which the installation-wide grant's `organization_limit` caps.
- `installation_grant` (Attributes) The installation-wide grant, which covers every organization without a grant of its own. Null while there is none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--licence--installation_grant))

<a id="nestedatt--licence--installation_grant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `licence.installation_grant`

Read-Only:

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the grant expires.
- `features` (List of String) The licensed features.
- `grace_until` (String) RFC 3339 time the grace period after expiry ends.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer of the grant.
- `not_before` (String) RFC 3339 time the grant starts.
- `organization_limit` (Number) Only on an installation-wide grant that carries one: the number of organizations the installation may enable. Null otherwise.
- `scope` (String) `organization` for a grant of the organization itself, which then decides alone, `installation` for an installation-wide grant.
- `sequence` (Number) The grant's sequence; a renewal has a higher one.
- `state` (String) `valid`, `grace`, `expired`, `not_yet_valid`, `revoked` or `untrusted` under the current issuer trust.
- `trust_class` (String) `production` or `development`.



<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `approval_policies` (Map of String) Deployment approval scope to authorization policy of the organization.
- `capability_registration` (String) Whether IAM holds the capability declarations of the served package for the organization: `registered`, `pending` until Core reconciled the served package, or `failed`, which Core retries.
- `licence_grant` (Attributes) The grant that covers the organization, its own or else the installation-wide grant. Null while none does or the package requires no licence. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations--licence_grant))
- `org_id` (String) The organization.
- `state` (String) `enabled` or `disabled`.
- `timezone` (String) The organization's IANA timezone for the plugin's calendar policies.

<a id="nestedatt--organizations--licence_grant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations.licence_grant`

Read-Only:

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the grant expires.
- `features` (List of String) The licensed features.
- `grace_until` (String) RFC 3339 time the grace period after expiry ends.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer of the grant.
- `not_before` (String) RFC 3339 time the grant starts.
- `organization_limit` (Number) Only on an installation-wide grant that carries one: the number of organizations the installation may enable. Null otherwise.
- `scope` (String) `organization` for a grant of the organization itself, which then decides alone, `installation` for an installation-wide grant.
- `sequence` (Number) The grant's sequence; a renewal has a higher one.
- `state` (String) `valid`, `grace`, `expired`, `not_yet_valid`, `revoked` or `untrusted` under the current issuer trust.
- `trust_class` (String) `production` or `development`.
